## Requirements that will not be built as written

Each of these is a permanent decision, not a backlog item: the technique it would need is one this project rules out (injection, hooking, patching, or constant screen capture). The closest possible treatment is named instead.

| Specification | Why it cannot be done, and what is done instead |
|---|---|
| §16 Selected/unselected clip styling, playhead styling | Clips and the playhead are painted by Premiere inside one window. Recolouring them means hooking its renderer - the definition of what this project does not do. Closest alternative: the timeline band, its separators and an accent line for the selected track. |
| §14-15 Dropdown and context menus as glass cards | Those popups belong to Premiere's process and are themed by Windows. No supported external theming exists. They stay exactly as they are. |
| §13 Buttons, §19 sliders/checkboxes/keyframes, §18 search field, §21 toolbar icons | Premiere's own drawing, with no HWND behind them. Alternative: region chrome around them (separators, bands, accents), which is what class C delivers. |
| §9-10 Background blur behind panels | Windows can blur only a process's own window. Blurring Premiere's pixels requires constant screen capture and reprojection - explicitly ruled out. Alternative: static gradients that read as depth. |
| §11 Panel hover/active/focus states on Premiere's panels | Premiere's panels never tell an outside process that the pointer is over them. Alternative: focus-aware treatment of the tracked window as a whole (active window vs. inactive), which is measurable. |

## Acceptance test (§45)

| Area | Row | Status | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Premiere | Opens / closes normally | done | Never a dependency: Azy attaches to a running process and detaches on exit |
| Premiere | Plays / scrubs normally | needs your machine | No hooks in the render path; needs one confirmation run |
| Premiere | Exports / imports / saves normally | needs your machine | Azy never opens, reads or writes a project |
| Input | Mouse, keyboard, shortcuts, dragging, timeline interaction | done | Click-through by construction; no input hooks of any kind |
| UI | No drift, no flicker, no black rectangles, no input-blocking areas | in progress | Probe + z-order guard; the region chrome still has to earn this |
| UI | Panels align correctly | needs your machine | The model is in and its geometry is unit-tested; confirming it against a real Premiere layout needs one debug screenshot |
| Performance | No continuous redraw, no playback FPS loss, no timeline latency | in progress | Event-driven and static; measurement script still to come |
| Scaling | 100 / 125 / 150 / 175 / 200% | needs your machine | DIP-based values and per-monitor DPI v2; one pass on real hardware to confirm |
| Displays | 1080p / 1440p / 4K / dual monitor | needs your machine | Geometry is monitor-relative and tested in unit tests; live pass pending |

Packaging and distribution: **done** — Installer, portable zip and source zip built by CI on every tag and attached to the GitHub release; local copies in release/.
